players.product: PVD sputtering and vacuum deposition systems for memory fabs

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (July - December 2025, semi-annual report): orders received JPY 137,105 million (+17.8% YoY), net sales JPY 123,893 million (-8.1%), operating profit JPY 8,456 million (-44.9%), ordinary profit JPY 9,154 million (-43.0%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 6,200 million (-40.5%). Vacuum Equipment: orders JPY 108,355 million, sales JPY 95,870 million, operating profit JPY 6,833 million; Vacuum Application: orders JPY 28,750 million, sales JPY 28,023 million, operating profit JPY 1,550 million. H1 R&D JPY 7,150 million. Management states power-device capex was being adjusted in the short term on slowing EV demand, while generative AI drove investment in advanced logic and next-generation memory.
